messages:
Alex: Quick sync — we need copy + mailing and webinar hooks for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Goal: one launch email sequence, hero variants for each mode, and a webinar landing CTA that routes inbound properly. Who can take hero lines?
Priya: I can. Thinking short, benefit-first. Drafts: Hosted: 'Start small. Scale fast.' Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput, zero surprises.' Private: 'Control your data. Run inference on your terms.' Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Jon: Nice. Can we call out the cost/latency benefit for Hosted in the subhead? e.g., 'Low-latency hosted API — production performance without ops.' Also we should include a metrics callout box referencing the benchmark narrative (throughput / avg p95 latency).
Marta: For the mailing sequence: 3 emails. 1) Launch announcement + hero variants with separate CTA urls (hosted/dedicated/private). 2) Benchmark highlights + one-pager PDF (asks for email capture). 3) Webinar invite + FAQ + routing to webinar page. Need utm/split details.
Alex: Good. For CTAs we want inbound routing (marketing -> product-qualified leads -> sales only for Dedicated/Private). Hosted should be fully self-serve. Marta can you propose redirect params?
Marta: Proposed links: /signup?mode=hosted&utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Dedicated: /contact-sales?mode=dedicated&utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Private: /contact-sales?mode=private&utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Also recommend adding a hidden param for cohort: &cohort=launch-2026 so we can filter in GA.
Priya: For hero variants I'll add a >40 char subhead for each with a micro-benefit + one-liner CTA. Example: Hosted subhead: 'Enterprise-grade latency, pay-as-you-go pricing.' CTA: 'Try Hosted — free credits'
Jon: On benchmarks, let's avoid raw numbers in hero. Use a micro-block: 'Benchmarked for 99th percentile latency at typical payloads — see benchmark page' and link to separate landing that has tables and graphs. Marketing-bot: Reminder: benchmark page must include methodology note and sample prompts.
marketing-bot: :robot_face: Checklist created: 1) hero copy variants, 2) email drafts, 3) benchmark one-pager, 4) webinar landing + registration form, 5) inbound routing rules. Owner tags: Priya (copy), Marta (routing + emails), Jon (benchmarks).
Alex: Webinar planning: 45 minutes — 25m demo (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private migration story), 15m Q&A, 5m CTA + next steps. We should capture attendees and tag mode interest automatically based on their RSVP selection.
Marta: For RSVP form, add a radio: 'I'm most interested in:' Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Hook should add ?mode=selected to the registration confirmation link. That will feed Pardot/HubSpot.
Priya: Email subject line tests: A1: 'Redwood Inference: production inference for every team' A2: 'Ship LLM features faster — hosted, dedicated, or private' Also include preview text variations: 'Live demo + benchmarks + migration playbook'.
Jon: For the benchmark narrative in email 2: keep it relatable — example use cases (chat, search embeddings) + token cost delta for batching/quantization. One callout: 'Up to 3x savings with caching & quantization on CPU-backed dedicated configs' (need legal review before publish).
Alex: Legal review noted. Priya — can you write short alt hero lines we can A/B test? Also we need microcopy for the three CTA buttons.
Priya: Will do. Draft microcopy ideas: Hosted CTA: 'Get started (free credits)' Dedicated CTA: 'Request reserved capacity' Private CTA: 'Schedule private deployment review'
Marta: Routing rules snippet for engineers (example):
```
# Nginx redirect example
location /launch-click {
  if ($arg_mode = "hosted") {
    return 302 https://app.redwood.ai/signup?utm_campaign=launch_q2;
  }
  if ($arg_mode = "dedicated") {
    return 302 https://www.redwood.ai/contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_q2&sales_route=dedicated;
  }
  if ($arg_mode = "private") {
    return 302 https://www.redwood.ai/contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_q2&sales_route=private;
  }
}
```
Priya: Love the snippet — will add a short line in the email that explains 'choosing Dedicated/Private will route you to our enterprise flow'.
Alex: Next steps: Priya deliver hero + button microcopy by EOD Wed. Marta deliver email copy + RSVP flow by Thu morning. Jon finalize benchmark language and legal check by Thu EOD. We'll run subject A/B for email 1 in the first send.
Marta: I'll add tagging rules for HubSpot and set up the UTMs. Also will add a hidden field for 'mode_interest'.
Jon: Quick note — ensure the webinar landing has a recording capture and post-event email with the one-pager + next-step links (same utm_cohort).
Alex: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket: — ping here when drafts are uploaded to the drive.
Priya: Uploaded hero comps to //drive/redwood/marketing/launch-copy/1719009999 (files: hero_hosted_v1.png, hero_dedicated_v1.png, hero_private_v1.png, ctas.md).
Marta: Draft emails in //drive/redwood/marketing/launch-copy/email-sequence (email_1.html, email_2.html, email_3.html).
Jon: Benchmark assets added to //drive/redwood/marketing/benchmarks/launch_q2 (bench_methods.md, charts.png).
marketing-bot: :white_check_mark: Campaign created in HubSpot: 'launch_q2_1719009999' — will start scheduled sends pending final approvals.
